scope: Real Swagger UI Execute interactions in installed Chrome, using the identified ES SDK artifact and loopback echo. Historical adapted case, not a broad browser benchmark.

candidate.invalid-array: Visible array validation error, no loader, no HTTP request
candidate.missing-array: Required-value validation error, no loader, no HTTP request
candidate.typed-array: One actual HTTP request with repeated values a and b
candidate.encoded-union: JSON text entered through the nullable-array textarea remains a string in parameter state; Execute produces actual repeated query values a and b
candidate.string-only: JSON-looking string remains exactly one string value in actual HTTP

additionalNegativeControls.neither-fixed.invalid-array: Invalid supplied value has no visible validation error and causes an actual request or remains loading throughout seven seconds
additionalNegativeControls.neither-fixed.encoded-union: Original UI reports required input missing despite supplied JSON text; no HTTP request
additionalNegativeControls.ui-only.encoded-union: Actual request incorrectly carries one JSON-encoded string instead of repeated a and b values

sdkOnlyNegativeControls.invalid-array: Loader remains throughout a seven-second observation, no visible validation error and no HTTP request
sdkOnlyNegativeControls.encoded-union: Original UI incorrectly reports required value missing despite supplied JSON text; no HTTP request

limits: Finite seven-second loader observation, not proof of infinite duration. Automated browser gestures are not a genuine human Switch message or approval. Only the declared nullable-array union is covered, not arbitrary JSON Schema unions.
